name: Pride And Prejudice 2: Pride Harder
source:
The latest in the Pride And Prejudice Fan Fiction series! Now with none of that parser stuff, 'cause that takes forever to program!

May contain loud noises!

[From [url=http://www.glorioustrainwrecks.com/node/978]Glorious Trainwrecks[/url]]
translation:
傲慢与偏见粉丝小说系列的最新作品！现在没有解析器的东西了，因为编程需要很长时间！

可能包含很大的噪音！

[来自[url=http://www.glorioustrainwrecks.com/node/978]Glorious Trainwrecks[/url]]
